lines.trans: Well, to be honest, not a very good one.
You never missed a single soccer match.
Being a father is not your strong suit.
Your calling is to be a great head chef.
Creating masterpieces—that is where your strength lies.
That is the exact thing I admire in you.
But if you give up right now...
Then you will never see me again.
You understand that Nagiyev will not let me win.
And perhaps this will help you?
What is this? It is a little gift for you.
